What it does

Motion automatically arranges your day around what is actually due, and rearranges it when a job runs long. For an owner-operator moving between estimates, site visits and admin, that removes a constant low-level planning burden. It only works if you commit to keeping your tasks in it rather than in your head.

Where the AI actually is

Automatically plans your day around priorities and deadlines.

Pros

  • Genuinely reduces planning overhead
  • Handles rescheduling when things run late
  • Useful when your day changes constantly

Cons

  • Premium pricing
  • Works best if you commit to using its system

Who it suits

Built with Remodelers & carpenters, General contractors, Electricians in mind. Owner-operators juggling estimates, site visits and admin.
